race.comment: BABUSHKA'S PRIDE (5) found 1000m way too slick when fresh from a spell here last start so that run can be forgiven. Won her maiden here at this trip by 4.3 lengths last time in work. Drawn to enjoy a perfect run and can improve sharply. MAGIC ROYALE (4) has progressed at each appearance this prep and capped it by collecting her maiden win a fortnight ago over 1175m at this track. Attacked the line with gusto that day which suggests this longer journey should be right up her alley. SENSESATIONAL STAR (10) has only won one race in 25 but recent efforts have been sound. Made late inroads to get up for third most recently over the mile here. Back in trip but worth an each-way investment. HIGH COUNTRY STAR (9) started at $1.45 first-up at Mansfield picnics but was beaten a whisker. Up in grade but capable of a top four finish. Last start Corowa maiden winner DUKE OF ZHOU (3) keeps improving and shouldn't find this out of reach.
